pages.text: With $(thing)CC: Tweaked$() installed, a computer can read and run the reactor.$(br2)Put a wired modem on the $(item)Reactor Core$(), any $(item)Reactor Port$() or the control console's bottom-left block. It shows up as a $(thing)bhe_reactor$() peripheral:$(br)$(thing)local r = peripheral.find("bhe_reactor")$()

pages.title: Reading
pages.text: $(thing)getStatus()$() returns everything at once. Or one at a time: getState, getStability, getStress, getRpm, getOffset, getTargetOffset, getLaserPower, getEnergy, getEnergyCapacity, getOutput, getMass, getStabilizerMasses, getTimer, getFault, getFaultSides, isFaultFixed, getBreakers, getResonance, getWobble, getAxialTrim, isFormed, isAxialFormed, isLanceFormed, isVentArmed.

pages.title: Controlling
pages.text: $(thing)ignite, shutdown, scram, jumpStart, reset, vent$() press the console's buttons and return what a player would have been told (nil if nothing). vent() arms the lance; call it again to fire.$(br2)$(thing)setTargetOffset(n), setLaserPower(n), setAxialTrim(n)$() set them directly; false while the reactor can't be adjusted.

pages.title: Example
pages.text: Keep the spin in the resonance band:$(br)$(thing)while true do$(br) local s = r.getStatus()$(br) local d = s.resonance.center - math.abs(s.rpm)$(br) if d > 100 then r.setTargetOffset(2)$(br) elseif d < -100 then r.setTargetOffset(-2)$(br) else r.setTargetOffset(0) end$(br) sleep(1)$(br)end$()
